subtitulo: Naming their interest before they do
descripcion: At C2 negotiation includes naming the other party's real interest before they do, which builds trust precisely because it shows you've understood their position better than a purely tactical move would require — and knowing when to concede something unprompted, before it's asked for, to change the frame of the whole exchange.

filas: I suspect what actually matters to you here is timing, not price.
Before you ask, I can already move on the delivery date.
changes it from a haggle to a joint problem

ejemplos.texto: I suspect what actually matters to you here is timing, not price — is that fair?
Before you even ask, I can move on the delivery date.
Let's treat this as a shared problem rather than two sides pulling in opposite directions.

notas: Naming the other side's real interest before they state it, and checking it (is that fair?), demonstrates genuine understanding rather than a tactical guess.
An unprompted concession, offered before it's requested, changes the frame from adversarial bargaining to joint problem-solving.
This only works if the named interest is actually accurate — a wrong guess here damages trust more than saying nothing.

es.en: Spanish has the same conditional tools for concessions («estaríamos dispuestos a… siempre que…» – we'd be willing to… provided that…), so the language transfers. The C2 point is to attach every concession to a condition in the same sentence, so that it strengthens rather than weakens the position.
es.es: El español tiene las mismas herramientas condicionales para hacer concesiones («estaríamos dispuestos a… siempre que…» – «we'd be willing to… provided that…»), por lo que el lenguaje se transfiere. El punto C2 es unir cada concesión a una condición en la misma oración, de modo que refuerce y no debilite la posición.

de.en: «Wir wären bereit, …, vorausgesetzt, dass…» corresponds exactly to we'd be willing to…, provided that…. German speakers therefore frame conditional concessions well in English.
de.de: «Wir wären bereit, …, vorausgesetzt, dass…» entspricht genau «we'd be willing to…, provided that…». Bedingte Zugeständnisse lassen sich daher gut übertragen.

it.en: «Saremmo disposti a… a patto che…» corresponds closely to we'd be willing to… provided that…. Note that «a patto che» takes the «congiuntivo», while provided that takes an ordinary present.
it.it: «Saremmo disposti a… a patto che…» corrisponde bene a «we'd be willing to… provided that…». Da notare che «a patto che» richiede il congiuntivo, mentre «provided that» prende un presente normale.

fr.en: «Nous serions prêts à… à condition que…» corresponds closely to we'd be willing to… provided that…. Note that «à condition que» takes the «subjonctif», while provided that takes an ordinary present.
fr.fr: «Nous serions prêts à… à condition que…» correspond étroitement à «we'd be willing to… provided that…». À noter que «à condition que» prend le subjonctif, alors que «provided that» prend un présent ordinaire.

pt.en: «Estaríamos dispostos a… desde que…» corresponds exactly to we'd be willing to… provided that…, with «desde que» in its conditional meaning. Conditional concessions therefore transfer directly.
pt.pt: «Estaríamos dispostos a… desde que…» corresponde exatamente a «we'd be willing to… provided that…», com «desde que» em sentido condicional. Concessões condicionais se transferem diretamente.

errores: Naming an interest that's actually wrong, which reads as presumptuous rather than perceptive.
Making an unprompted concession so large it signals weakness rather than good faith.
Reframing to shared problem-solving rhetorically while still negotiating adversarially underneath.

es: «*Con la condición de que*» rendered as *With the condition that* instead of *On condition that* or *Provided that*.
de: «*Unter der Bedingung, dass*» rendered as *Under the condition that* instead of *On condition that*.
it: «*A condizione che*» rendered as *At condition that* instead of *On condition that*.
fr: «*À condition que*» rendered as *At condition that* instead of *On condition that*.
pt: «*Com a condição de*» rendered as *With the condition of* instead of *On condition that*.

traducciones.de: auf dem Weg der Besserung sein

redemittel.expresion: I suspect what actually matters to you is…

traducciones.es: Sospecho que lo que realmente te importa es…
traducciones.de: Ich vermute, was dir wirklich wichtig ist, ist…
traducciones.fr: Je soupçonne que ce qui compte vraiment pour toi, c’est…
traducciones.it: Sospetto che ciò che conta davvero per te sia…
traducciones.pt: Suspeito que o que realmente importa para ti é…

redemittel.expresion: Before you ask, I can already…

traducciones.es: Antes de que preguntes, ya puedo…
traducciones.de: Bevor du fragst, kann ich schon…
traducciones.fr: Avant que tu ne poses la question, je peux déjà…
traducciones.it: Prima che tu lo chieda, posso già…

redemittel.expresion: Let's treat this as a shared problem.

traducciones.es: Tratemos esto como un problema compartido.
traducciones.de: Betrachten wir das als gemeinsames Problem.
traducciones.fr: Considérons cela comme un problème commun.
traducciones.pt: Tratemos isto como um problema comum.

redemittel.expresion: Is that a fair read of where you're coming from?

traducciones.es: ¿Es una lectura justa de tu posición?
traducciones.de: Ist das eine faire Einschätzung deiner Position?
traducciones.fr: Est-ce une lecture juste de ta position ?
traducciones.it: È una lettura corretta della tua posizione?
traducciones.pt: É uma leitura justa da tua posição?

redemittel.expresion: That's not a concession I need you to earn.

traducciones.es: No es una concesión que necesites ganarte.
traducciones.de: Das ist kein Zugeständnis, das du dir verdienen musst.
traducciones.fr: Ce n’est pas une concession que tu dois mériter.
traducciones.it: Non è una concessione che devi guadagnarti.
traducciones.pt: Não é uma concessão que tenhas de merecer.

redemittel.expresion: What would actually solve this for both of us?

traducciones.de: Was würde das tatsächlich für uns beide lösen?
traducciones.fr: Qu’est-ce qui réglerait réellement cela pour nous deux ?
traducciones.it: Che cosa risolverebbe davvero questo per entrambi?
traducciones.pt: O que resolveria isto de facto para nós os dois?

redemittel.expresion: Tell me where I've read you wrong.
redemittel.funcion: invites correction of the interest you named

traducciones.es: Decime en qué te leí mal.
traducciones.de: Sagen Sie mir, wo ich Sie falsch verstanden habe.
traducciones.fr: Dites-moi en quoi je vous ai mal lu.
traducciones.it: Mi dica dove l'ho letta male.

redemittel.expresion: That's the one thing I can't move on.
redemittel.funcion: marks the hard limit without theatre

traducciones.es: Eso es lo único en lo que no me puedo mover.
traducciones.de: Das ist der eine Punkt, bei dem ich nicht nachgeben kann.
traducciones.fr: C'est le seul point sur lequel je ne peux pas bouger.
traducciones.it: È l'unico punto su cui non posso cedere.
traducciones.pt: É o único ponto em que não posso ceder.

redemittel.funcion: shows the real room alongside the limit

redemittel.expresion: What does this look like from your side of the table?
redemittel.funcion: asks for their framing before proposing

traducciones.es: ¿Cómo se ve esto desde tu lado de la mesa?
traducciones.de: Wie sieht das von Ihrer Seite des Tisches aus?
traducciones.fr: À quoi cela ressemble-t-il de votre côté de la table ?
traducciones.it: Come appare questo dalla sua parte del tavolo?
traducciones.pt: Como é que isto se vê do teu lado da mesa?

redemittel.expresion: If we can't agree today, what's the cost of waiting?

traducciones.es: Si hoy no acordamos, ¿cuál es el costo de esperar?
traducciones.de: Wenn wir uns heute nicht einigen: Was kostet das Warten?
traducciones.fr: Si nous ne nous entendons pas aujourd'hui, que coûte l'attente ?
traducciones.it: Se oggi non ci accordiamo, quanto costa aspettare?
traducciones.pt: Se hoje não acordarmos, qual é o custo de esperar?

redemittel.expresion: Let's write down what we've agreed so far.

traducciones.de: Halten wir fest, worauf wir uns schon geeinigt haben.
traducciones.fr: Notons ce sur quoi nous nous sommes déjà entendus.
traducciones.it: Mettiamo per iscritto ciò su cui siamo già d'accordo.

mision.consigna: Negotiate a phased return to work after a long illness with a manager who's nervous about it.
requisitos: name the manager's real interest before they state it
one *Is that a fair read of where you're coming from?*
one concession given freely, not traded
use *a chronic condition*, *a relapse* and *to be on the mend*

microtareas.texto: Write the three interests a manager might have that they won't say aloud.
Write your opening line naming one of them.
Record 2 minutes negotiating from a *holistic* view of your recovery.

autochequeo: Is the named interest checked, not just asserted?
Is any unprompted concession proportionate, not a signal of weakness?
Does the reframing to joint problem-solving hold up in substance, not just rhetoric?
Would the other party feel genuinely understood, not managed?
Is the tone collaborative throughout, not adversarial underneath a collaborative surface?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on whether the other party's interest is named accurately and checked, and whether any concession or reframing is genuine. Do not rewrite the text.
